in_sanskrit.name: दशरथि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ten qualities of Rathi (chariot), belonging to Rama's father Dasharatha.

in_hindi.name: दशरथी
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ten-headed (Dashanana) or Ten-attributed (Dashaguna) king, lord, or master. Derived from Dasharatha.

in_tamil.name: தசரதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ten virtues or qualities of Rama's father Dasharatha.

in_telugu.name: దశరథి
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ten virtuous qualities or ten glorious attributes of Dasharatha, the father of Rama.

in_marathi.name: Dasharathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ten Characters, or Ten Kings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dasharathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dasharathi refers to King Dasharatha, known for his ten virtuous qualities and his ten sons, including Rama and Lakshmana. This name symbolizes strong leadership, morality, and family values.

This name symbolizes strong leadership, morality, and family values.
